text_block_list.text:
Preparations were underway for the
fan meeting, a joint project with the racetrack. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Horse Girl-san!
Mom, Dad, and I are definitely going
to the fan meeting! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um... our whole family is always cheering for you.
Preparing for it must be tough, but...
Please keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you so much~!
...Ehehe, we got cheered on!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Cheering"—is "COMF"...
...It's "mutef", isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The breeze is stronger than expected...
Should we reduce the iced cups...
and prepare more hot cups instead...?

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wow... thanks for your hard work, Cafe-san.
You're attentive down to the smallest detail.
Truly impressive, putting adults to shame!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is... that so?

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the fans will be thrilled!
Especially since you're preparing everything
with such great care.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's the perfect opportunity to meet
each other directly. Everyone's feelings of gratitude
will surely reach them!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
...Feelings... of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
...I have to make sure nothing goes wrong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
That should be enough for today—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!
Ayabe-san... you're Ayabe-san, right!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I am.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow... the real thing...!?
I-I'm a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm always cheering for you... Actually,
I saw you earlier and wanted to call out, but
you looked so busy... so, um.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to the fan meeting!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just working behind the scenes.
I apologize, but I won't be appearing on stage.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Eh... oh, is that so?
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
B-But I'm still really looking forward to it...
and I'm happy either way!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...? Why... would you be happy...?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm happy!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for bothering you!
Well then... I'm really looking forward to the day!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Right.
I'll make it a success... definitely...

Her determined eyes looked up.
The support of so many people seemed to have
sparked a fiery resolve within Admire Vega.
